topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Well, neighbor, it seems the times are changing even faster than the spring harvest. I do wish you strength, knowing your home is turning to condos. It’s a strange thing, this city way of living, so different from the old fields we till. Yet, here you are, amidst bricks and stones, where roots run deep too, in their own way. I reckon it’s a hard trial, losing the comfort of what was known. But think of it, a new beginning might bring good fortune. May the saints watch over you, guiding your path to a place of peace. I’ll hold you in my thoughts, sending you the warmth of the hearth and the comfort of home, wherever that may be.
